Class JsonDataObjectSerializer<T>

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Serialization
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Provides serialization and deserialization functionality for T objects using System.Text.Json.

public class JsonDataObjectSerializer<T> where T : DataObject

Type Parameters

T

The type of DataObject to serialize/deserialize. T must inherit from DataObject.

Remarks

This class supports custom JsonSerializerOptions and static serialization methods for flexibility. Use Serialize(T) and Deserialize(string) for instance-based operations, or the static methods for generic usage.
